purpose: Qualify AtomGit-hosted models as isolated experimental subjects for later optional robustness/reviewer panels; do not alter or execute the frozen E2-R17 R3D scientific lineage.

transport.retry_policy: no automatic retry in qualification accounting

phase_1_repeatability_if_phase_0_passes.purpose: Estimate byte-level and semantic output stability under provider-managed sampling; not an E2 scientific effect test.

forbidden_inputs: any outcome used to choose the primary frozen model
later_eligible_roles: optional D1 cross-backbone robustness after the primary gate
selection_rule: Never select an AtomGit model by favorable E2 effect. For any later optional role, select prospectively using runtime validity, harness compatibility, stability, marginal cost, and literature relevance.
